description: This file contains unit tests for verifying the functionality of the Orleans reminders table implementation using PostgreSQL as the backend storage. It defines a test class with multiple test methods for different reminder table operations, sets up the PostgreSQL-specific configuration, and references external dependencies related to Orleans, AdoNet, and testing utilities.

classes.name: PostgreSqlRemindersTableTests
classes.description: A test class for Orleans reminders table operations with PostgreSQL, inheriting from ReminderTableTestsBase. It includes setup for PostgreSQL-specific options and several unit test methods.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Creates logger filter options with Trace level for the test class.

methods.name: CreateRemindersTable
methods.description: Creates an instance of AdoNetReminderTable configured for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: GetAdoInvariant
methods.description: Returns the AdoNet invariant string for PostgreSQL based on static constant.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Asynchronously sets up and retrieves the PostgreSQL connection string for testing.

methods.name: RemindersTable_PostgreSql_Init
methods.description: A placeholder for a test that initializes the reminders table; currently empty.

methods.name: RemindersTable_PostgreSql_RemindersRange
methods.description: A test method that verifies reminders within a specified range, runs 50 iterations.

methods.name: RemindersTable_PostgreSql_RemindersParallelUpsert
methods.description: A test method for verifying parallel upsert operations on reminders.

methods.name: RemindersTable_PostgreSql_ReminderSimple
methods.description: A test method for simple reminder functionality.
